meta.task: Design a battery for grid energy storage: energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg; support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating); anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles of 1C cycling; discharge capacity retention >= 90% at -20C; SEI <= 550 nm after 500 cycles. Ablation: ceiling_escalation OFF.

goal_parse.energy_density_wh_kg: >= 327.18 Wh/kg (calc-energy contract caliber, electrolyte excluded from mass)
goal_parse.fast_charge: 4C charge at 45 C ambient (protocol 4C_charge_45C), plating = anode_potential_v min < 0 V
goal_parse.sei_100cyc: anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 x 1C cycles (aging_1C_100cyc, key sei_thickness_nm_end)
goal_parse.lowT_retention: discharge capacity retention at -20 C >= 90% = capacity_ah(lowT_discharge, 253.15K) / capacity_ah(1C_discharge, 298.15K)
goal_parse.T_max_note: task text specifies no maximum-temperature red line; T_max_K recorded in metrics, not adjudicated

meta.start_stage_reason: objective involves no new materials/additives/electrolyte design and no electrode-modification materials named in task text -> start at Stage 3 (cell design); materials use system baseline parameters
meta.base_reason: task text names no electrode system -> anchor table deterministic mapping: default Chen2020; dump verified (93 keys, incl. 'SEI kinetic rate constant [m.s-1]' so aging-capable; pure-graphite negative, no SiOx cracking keys; NMC811 positive; full geometry/thermal keys present)
meta.stage1_note: start_stage=3: no molecular candidates screened; stage1 elimination lines not registered (empty)

ceiling_escalation.consequence: no proactive material-design escalation; use only materials/systems named in task text, otherwise tune within the existing cell/architecture formulation space

funnel_voting.note: moot: start_stage=3, no molecular funnel runs

electrode_system.basis: task text names no system and ablation note restricts to systems named in task text -> locked to default Chen2020

electrolyte_formulation.basis: not declared in task text -> widest interpretation (t1_r1 lesson); levers: Electrolyte conductivity [S.m-1], Electrolyte diffusivity [m2.s-1], Cation transference number

electrode_modification.basis: coating/doping is material design; no material named in task text; ceiling_escalation OFF forbids proactive material design

cell_architecture.basis: ablation note explicitly allows tuning within the existing cell/architecture formulation space; levers: electrode thickness, porosity, N/P, separator thickness/porosity, current collector thickness, particle radius

thermal_management.basis: not declared in task text -> widest interpretation; lever: Total heat transfer coefficient [W.m-2.K-1]

bookkeeping.nominal_capacity: when architecture changes capacity, Nominal cell capacity [A.h] is updated to the design's measured 1C discharge capacity (mechanically derived) so 1C/4C C-rate definitions stay honest; consistency parameter, not a design lever
bookkeeping.derived_metrics: sei_100cyc_nm / sei_500cyc_nm / lowT_retention are mechanically derived from tool outputs into derived JSON files (formulas recorded in log) and passed to log-evaluate alongside raw outputs
bookkeeping.sei_key_note: aging output key sei_thickness_nm_end is the negative-electrode end-of-run max thickness in nm; 100c and 500c have different thresholds so distinct derived keys are used
